summary: The study investigates the selective hydrogenation of citral to citronellol using Ni-supported catalysts prepared by atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) and incipient wetness methods. The highest selectivity to citronellol was achieved with a Ni/Al2O3 catalyst prepared by ALE at 400 ◦C, showing the potential of ALE in liquid-phase hydrogenation.
evidence: The highest maximum selectivity to citronellol was 82% in ethanol at 70 ◦C and 5.3 bar hydrogen with this catalyst, which was reduced at 400 ◦C. The ALE technique allows for molecular-level control and homogeneous distribution of surface species, leading to higher specific metal surface area and improved hydrogenation rates.
